messages:
maria (sales): Heads-up — large financial customer wants an air-gapped POC. Key asks: deterministic upgrade path (they want small deltas if possible), signed patch delivery, offline license activation tied to hostname, and clear pricing for a 6-week eval that could convert to reserved nodes. Can we meet them?

devin (solutions): Yes. We can do a single-file install bundle plus optional delta packages. Deltas are generated as signed binary diffs against a specific base bundle-id. We provide a signed manifest with sequence numbers.

aya (eng): Notes: deltas are efficient for minor updates but require exact base checksum. If they skip an interim patch we will require applying intermediate deltas or fallback to full bundle. Also need to confirm their GPU driver & container runtime versions.

ben (cs): Typical POC: 6-week eval license (timebound), support hours included (remote by default). For airgapped we add a fixed setup fee for onsite/engineer-assisted installs or secure-bastion coordination. If they convert to reserved capacity within 90 days we credit the setup fee.

maria (sales): They asked about license activation: can we bind to hostname or hardware ID?

tara (security): We support offline license tokens signed with our private key. Token contains: entitlements, expiration, bundle-id, and allowed hostname(s) or hwid. The installer verifies the signature with our public cert. We also support HSM-imported public keys if they want to validate on their side.

devin (solutions): Example manifest snippet we can share: 

```
# manifest.json (signed)
{
  "bundle_id": "2026Q1-rl-001",
  "sequence": 3,
  "delta_from": "2026Q1-rl-000",
  "files": ["runtime.tar.gz","models.qpack"],
  "sha256": "ab12...",
  "signature": "MEUCIQ..."
}
```

aya (eng): Installer preflight we give customers: OS kernel, glibc, NVIDIA driver, containerd/docker version, free disk, and cgroup settings. We include a `preflight.sh` they run and paste output back to us for quick triage.

maria (sales): Ok. Upgrade cadence — they want to know how often critical/security patches are published and whether we can push them.

ben (cs): We do monthly security rollups and quarterly feature bundles by default. For airgapped installs we publish signed rollups; we don't push. We can offer a managed-update add-on where we coordinate a temporary egress window or an engineer-assisted update during a maintenance window.

tara (security): Compliance: we'll need completed export + crypto questionnaires. For FIPS / PCI customers we may need to provide a FIPS-compatible build; that affects delivery lead time. Also recommend they run our filesystem integrity check after install.

contracts-bot: Contract note — offline delivery requires an MSA addendum: addendum_offline_delivery_v1 to be signed. Also check export control clause.

devin (solutions): For delta application we have an `apply-delta` tool that validates sequence and signature: 

```
./apply-delta --manifest manifest.json --delta delta-0003.bin --license /tmp/license.token
```

Output shows staged files and a rollback marker. We always create a safe rollback snapshot before applying.

aya (eng): Edge case: if their nodes have very old kernels we may need to ship a compatibility shim which increases bundle size. We'll call that out in the preflight.

maria (sales): Pricing specifics they asked for: flat POC fee, per-node reserved price, and an option for managed updates. Can we get a ballpark?

ben (cs): Ballpark: POC flat fee $30K (6 weeks, includes 8 support hours + packaging). Reserved capacity pricing: per-GPU monthly rate (depends on GPU class); sample: A100-class equivalent $9K/GPU/month. Managed update add-on $2K/month for the cluster (up to N nodes) or per-update engineer day rate. We'll produce an exact quote after we know node counts.

maria (sales): Action items: 1) Draft POC quote + addendum (ben + contracts-bot) 2) Preflight script + packaging checklist (aya + devin) 3) License activation flow doc + sample token (tara) — aim to send customer by EOW.

ops-bot: Created ticket SLD-2201 "airgap poc: packaging + delta flow" assigned to aya/devin/ben  due 2026-04-12.

maria (sales): I'll collect their inventory sheet (OS, kernel, drivers, disk) and export questionnaire. Thanks all :rocket:
